tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

tools.name: list_subagent_models
tools.description: Inspect the routes available for explicit subagent model selection. No arguments: authorized providers. `provider`: that provider's authorized models. `provider` + `model`: that model and its reasoning efforts. Query when choosing an explicit child route or reasoning effort. Omit optional fields rather than sending empty strings.

model.description: Exact model id; requires provider.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: AI 主动维护长期记忆(做梦式固化):读最近 days 天的工作日志,由 AI 发散提炼出有跨会话长期价值的决策/架构/用户偏好,自动写入项目笔记 MEMORY.md(带日期标题)与用户级 MEMORY.md(跨项目规则),并在正文向用户转述固化结果。★**与「自动沉淀」的边界**:每轮对话结束框架会**自动**评估并写日志/升格要点,**你不需要为日常轮次做这件事**;本工具是**你主动发起的加料**——隔一段时间(或一个阶段收尾时)用来做一次更彻底的提炼,读的是**多日日志**、输出进项目笔记与用户级记忆。⇒ 用它做「阶段性固化」,不要用它替代每轮的 memory_log。

days.description: 读取最近 N 天日志,缺省 7,上限 30。

tools.name: memory_expand
tools.description: 白板结构化展开(P3, 需 boardMode=graph):正向遍历——给定 tag(如 type:dead-end / topic:登录)展开所有匹配的账本/白板条目 Content,默认 limit 10、硬帽 20。返回条目 id、标题、来源(source 文件+行)与判据状态。适合主动重建上下文(如「把所有失败方案列出来」)。

tag.description: 要展开的 tag,如 type:dead-end 或 topic:主题名。

limit.description: 返回条数上限,缺省 10,硬帽 20。

tools.name: memory_external
tools.description: 查看/接入其他 AI 工具(AI 助手/CodeBuddy/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Kimi Code/TRAE/项目约定文件)的记忆。action=list 列出全部检测到的外部记忆源(路径/大小/预览/会话数);action=import **以纯链接模式**接入(source 为源 id,target=project 接进项目笔记 / user 接进用户级记忆)。★**「纯链接模式」的含义**:只在你的记忆里写一条**源文件绝对路径指针**,**不把对方内容抄进来**——目的是①防外部脏内容混入、②对方内容会变而指针不会过期。⇒ 需要内容时**按指针路径读取原文件**或记忆里说明的路径,不要去猜。★首次在新工作区工作时先 list,判断该项目是否曾在其他 AI 工具里做过。首次在新工作区工作、或用户提到其他软件里做过的事时调用。

action.description: list=列出外部记忆源; import=接入指定源。

source.description: 要接入的源 id(action=import 时必填,来自 list 结果)。

target.description: 接入目标: project=项目笔记(默认), user=用户级记忆。

tools.name: memory_log
tools.description: 向当前工作区的 .dsh-memory/ 今日日志追加一条工作记录(append-only,自动建目录/文件)。完成实质性工作(改代码/修 bug/写文档/重构/技术选型/用户偏好约定)后必须调用;有跨会话长期价值的内容在同一轮内一并写入记忆(memory_note 项目/ memory_user 跨项目),progress 与 memory 一起写;不要记录临时信息。**★顺手维护白板(G4/M3,2026-09-17)**:若本次工作让**白板或账本所述与现状不符**(方向变了/阶段完成/旧结论被推翻),请在同一次回复里顺带调用 `memory_note`:项目稳定事实变了用 `kind=plan` 重写白板(旧版自动归档),动态状态变了用 `kind=handoff` 新开一篇账本(append-only,不追改旧账本)。**这是条件触发,不是每回都做**;白板功能关闭时跳过即可,不要因此报错。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文(摘要可见的正文,不是工具调用区)中向用户转述一句:如"已把 X 记入今日日志"**。

note.description: 简短条目:一句话概括做了什么、结果如何。

date.description: 日志日期 YYYY-MM-DD,**缺省今天**。★可补写过去某天(如补记昨天的工作)——会写进那一天的文件,不会覆盖同文件已有内容(append-only)。格式非法时静默回退到今天。

kind.description: ★P6B:条目性质标记(缺省 fact)。rule=用户规则/约定;preference=偏好;todo=待办;fact=事实记录。是规则或用户明确约定的条目请传 kind=rule——它会被规则层识别为必须遵守的约束。纯标记、零额外 LLM 调用。

tools.name: memory_maintain
tools.description: 维护记忆(30 天蒸馏):把 days(缺省30)天前的 .dsh-memory/ 每日日志交给 AI 蒸馏提炼出有长期价值的要点写入项目 MEMORY.md,原文保底归档到 .dsh-memory/archive/ 后从活跃日志移除。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档,不丢信息。★**归档语义(2026-10-13)**:归档 = 冷存储,原文退出常规检索面(**不进 memory_recall 的 all**),只有蒸馏要点经项目笔记继续参与唤回;**不再把全文回灌项目笔记**(那是注入面,回灌会撑大窗口)。取回归档原文:**列目录** memory_read(kind="archive")、**按键找** memory_recall(scope="archive", query="…")、**取全文** memory_read(kind="archive", name="…")。任何情况下都不删归档副本。

days.description: **归档阈值天数**,缺省 30。语义:把**早于「今天 − days 天」**的每日日志挑出来蒸馏,不是「最近 days 天」。**只影响活跃日志的可见性,不删信息**——要点进 MEMORY.md,原文整份归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档。★属**低频维护动作**,不要每轮调。

tools.name: memory_note
tools.description: 更新当前项目长期笔记 .dsh-memory/MEMORY.md(本项目专属的约定、决策、架构要点),或写交接白板。kind=note(默认):action=append 追加一段(自动带日期标题)/action=replace 整体替换(需先基于注入内容或 memory_recall 结果给出完整新内容),本项目笔记有**容量上限**(字符,设置项 noteCapacityChars,默认 24000);**超出时的行为**(你不需要自己控制长度,写就是):①先把较早内容交给 AI 折叠成要点(同一层 10 分钟内只整理一次);②整理失败则**整条原文**归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`(信息不丢);③整理后仍超才拒绝(正常不会发生)。kind=handoff:写一篇四段式交接账本(任务状态/目标/已试方案与失败原因/进度与下一步)到 handoff/,阶段产出或方向变化时用,给下一个上下文窗口续命;**账本/白板内容要落进面板看板泳道,须在标题或正文写 tag**:type:goal / type:state / type:dead-end / type:progress。kind=plan:先 memory_read(kind=plan) 获取版本再写入共享白板 PLAN.md(人能读的项目全貌规划图)。**首建亦可**——工作区若还没有白板,宿主已自动落了一版骨架,你理解全貌后直接整体重写成真内容即可;对项目全貌的理解发生实质变化时同样重写。旧版自动归档。**别把骨架留在那里当白板**。★白板判据 P-H1(硬性):重写后的 PLAN 必须含**至少 1 个 `## ` 顶层节、且该节正文 ≥20 个非空白字符**——只写标题+引言(没有任何成段的 ## 节)会被判据门拒绝。**结论失效时的两个通道(不要混用)**:supersedes=被更新结论取代(有后继);retract=**当时就做错了、直接撤回**(无后继,本身即教训)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:更新了什么**。

content.description: 笔记内容。kind=plan 整篇替换给完整新全貌并带 expectedRevision；单卡更新给完整卡片并带 cardId/expectedCardRevision。

action.description: 仅 kind=note 时有效:append=追加, replace=整体替换。

kind.description: note=项目笔记(默认), handoff=四段式交接账本(新篇), plan=白板全貌重写。 ★plan 重写前必须先 read 磁盘 handoff/PLAN.md 的**原文**并逐条抄回全部 <!--memory:mem_*--> 锚点：注入快照会被截断(显示「…(截断,全文见 handoff/ 白板与账本)」)，不足以据此重写；缺锚点会被保护门拒绝(它会逐条比对前后卡片集合)。每张卡的原文与其用户备注区必须原样带回。

expectedRevision.description: plan 整篇重写必填：memory_read(kind=plan) 返回的 revision。过时版本返回冲突保存路径，不覆盖。

cardId.description: plan 可选条目更新：content 仅提供这一张完整卡（含原锚点），其余卡片保持原文。

expectedCardRevision.description: cardId 更新必填：memory_read(kind=plan) cards 中该卡片 revision。

supersedes.description: （可选）要标为 superseded 的旧条目 memoryId 列表（mem_<32hex>）。**仅在你明确知道被取代的是哪条时传**；不确定就不要传。会在旧条目正文末尾追加一行 `<!-- dsh-status: superseded by=<新条目id> -->`。

retract.description: （可选）要标为 **retracted（撤回）** 的旧条目 memoryId 列表（mem_<32hex>）。**与 supersedes 的分工**：supersedes = 被**更新的结论取代**（有后继结论，可追 mem_id）；**retract = 当时就做错了、直接撤回**（无后继，"错误本身"就是教训）。用户裁定「retracted 不是垃圾，是教训，不过滤只备注」⇒ 检索仍会返回它并标 ⚠已撤回。**强烈建议同时传 retractReason 说明错在哪**。仅在你确知标错的是哪条时传。

retractReason.description: （可选，配合 retract）撤回原因，一行内说明**错在哪**，上限 120 字符。会写成 `reason="…"` 附在状态行上，供检索时显示。

restore.description: （可选）**撤销通道**：把指定 memoryId 的状态改回 current（移除状态行）。用于纠正标错的 superseded/retracted。

archivedIds.description: （可选，仅 kind=plan 有意义）要**显式归档**的卡片 id 列表（mem_<32hex>）。用于白板重写时有意移除某张卡：列进来即视为"合法消失（有留痕）"，不会被丢卡检查拦下。**只在你确实要移除该卡时传**；顺手漏抄卡片不要用它掩盖——那属于内容丢失，应改回原样带回。

tools.name: memory_procedure
tools.description: 把一个**值得复用的流程**写进 procedure memory（技能库）——这是模型直写通路，取代此前的机械生成。什么时候用：你刚跑通了一个多步骤流程、踩坑后总结出了正确做法、或发现某个操作值得下次照做时。**判据**：有明确步骤、可重复、下次遇到类似场景能直接照做。**已有条目要改就用 action=update（传 procedureId），不要另写一条同名新条目**；action=write 进审批列表（保守，推荐先这样）；action=activate 一步到位激活并可被自动召回（仅当你确信它稳定可复用）。写出的条目须含 title + steps，建议一并给 successCriteria（**没有 successCriteria 的条目永远无法晋升**）。

action.description: write=写入并进审批列表（默认）；activate=写入后直接晋升并激活（可被召回，同时自动导出 SKILL.md）。

procedureId.description: 仅 action=update 时需要：要修订的条目 id（完整或前 20 位短码）。

title.description: 一句话说清这是什么流程（如「发布前跑全量回归并核对 SHA256」）。不要用运行时样板文字或纯提问句。**action=write/activate 必填**（缺则明确拒绝）；**action=update 可省略**（要改标题才传）。

steps.description: 流程步骤，**一行一步**（换行分隔）；行首的 "1. " / "- " 会自动去掉。**action=write/activate 必填**（缺则明确拒绝）。

successCriteria.description: 怎么算跑通，一行一条。**强烈建议填写**——缺它则该条目结构上无法晋升。

preconditions.description: 前置条件，一行一条（可选）。

checks.description: 过程中要检查的点，一行一条（可选）。

rollback.description: 失败时怎么回滚，一行一条（可选）。

riskLevel.description: 风险等级，缺省 low。high 会要求人工批准后才可激活。

tools.name: memory_procedure_list
tools.description: 只读浏览技能库(procedure memory)：列出两库里已有哪些流程条目，含**它属于哪个库**（工作区库 / 通用库）、阶段、证据量与「为什么还不能晋升」的原因码。用于**动手写之前先查重**：你要写的流程是否已经存在？是补修它还是新建？也可用 query 做关键词粗筛。**本工具纯只读，不写盘、不晋升、不改任何条目。**

scope.description: 只看哪个库：workspace=工作区库 / global=通用库 / all=两库都看（默认）。

query.description: 关键词粗筛（匹配标题/步骤/完成标准，不区分大小写；可选）。

limit.description: 最多返回条数，缺省 30，硬帽 100。

includeNoise.description: ★#453：是否包含「低质量观察行」（纯 episode 观察行 / 缺 successCriteria 的候选）。缺省 false = 折叠并在末尾提示条数；传 true 才全部列出。

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: 按需读取记忆文件完整内容(某日日志/反思全文、用户级记忆、项目笔记、日历、**已归档旧日志**),注入上下文只含精简摘要,需要细节时用本工具,不要要求用户粘贴。★**kind=archive 是取回 30 天前归档原文的入口**——归档后原文退出常规检索面(冷存储分层),需显式取;可用 memory_recall(scope="archive") 先找文件名。

kind.description: 读取类型: log=某日日志, reflection=某日反思, user=用户级记忆, notes=项目笔记, calendar=日历, plan=白板, **archive=已归档的旧日志(30 天前的日志原文,冷存储,不在常规检索面,需显式取)**。

name.description: 仅 kind=archive:归档文件名(如 2026-01-01.md)。**缺省=列出全部归档文件**;给了=返回该文件全文。可用 memory_recall(scope="archive") 先按关键词定位文件名。

date.description: 日期 YYYY-MM-DD(仅 log/reflection 需要,缺省今天)。

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: 检索记忆:本地记忆文件(当前工作区 + 其他所有工作区的每日日志、项目笔记、用户级记忆、反思、交接白板)关键词匹配 + 历史 DSH 会话全文检索(如部署启用)。开发/排查中不懂的、用户提到过去的做法/讨论/决定而当前上下文没有时调用——跨工作区的记忆也能检索到(结果标注来源工作区)。查询必须自包含。默认返回 L0 摘要列表(每条含 id/得分/匹配原因,省 token);需要某条完整原文时传 expand="mem_xxx" 按需展开(渐进式加载)。scope=handoff 只搜交接白板语料(白板 PLAN+交接账本——接续长任务时先查这里);scope=sessions 只搜历史会话；**scope=archive 检索 30 天前的已归档旧日志**(归档原文退出常规面属冷存储分层,不在 all 里;命中给文件名+命中行,正文用 memory_read(kind="archive", name=…) 取)。**检索后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:检索了什么、找到什么(或没找到)**。

query.description: 检索关键词或自包含描述;expand 时填该记忆 id 即可。

limit.description: 最多返回条数,缺省 8。

scope.description: 检索范围:all=全部(默认,**不含 archive**), handoff=交接白板语料(跨窗口续命材料), sessions=历史 DSH 会话, **archive=已归档的旧日志(30 天前原文,冷存储,需显式指定)**。★命中给「文件名+命中行」,正文用 memory_read(kind="archive", name=…) 取(两段式)。

format.description: 本地记忆命中格式:l0=L0 摘要列表(默认,每条含 id/得分/匹配原因),full=整条原文(旧行为)。

expand.description: 按记忆 id(mem_ + 32 个十六进制字符)展开该条完整原文。★**提供 expand 时 query 只作占位、检索语义被忽略**(仍必填,随便填该 id 即可);这是**两段式用法**:先用默认 l0 拿到候选列表与 id,再对感兴趣的那条 expand 取全文,避免一次性灌入大量原文。

tools.name: memory_reflect
tools.description: 保存每日反思。★**触发条件严格**:仅在收到框架的「昨日反思待生成」提示、且**已在回复正文中向用户呈现了反思内容之后**才调用——不是你想反思就反思。落盘到 .dsh-memory/reflections/YYYY-MM-DD.md 并标记该日完成(标记后当天不再提示)。date 传**被反思那天的日志日期**(通常是昨天),不是今天。

date.description: 反思对应的日期 YYYY-MM-DD(即被反思那天的日志日期)。

text.description: 完整反思内容:成果回顾 / 教训改进 / 今日可延续要点。

tools.name: memory_rules
tools.description: 用户级硬性约束(每轮无条件注入的 [规则] 段,真源 ~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md)的**条目级增删改**。op=list 列出全部条目(0 基序号/来源日期段/文本);op=add 追加;op=update 改写一条;op=remove **真删**一条。★**删/改必须带 expect**(=该条**当前**文本,从 list 原样回填),不符即拒 —— 防索引漂移删错行。★这段**每轮注入且不参与裁剪**,所以它同时是 prompt 成本的主要来源:清理过时条目的首选手段就是本工具的 remove(而不是把整篇用户级记忆用 memory_user replace 重写)。★status 被标 superseded/retracted 的条目自 P9 起**不再进规则段**,但仍留在 list 里(要彻底消失用 remove;要软失效用 memory_note 的 retract/supersedes)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述改了什么**。

op.description: list=列出; add=追加; update=改写一条(需 index+expect+content); remove=真删一条(需 index+expect)。

index.description: 条目序号(0 基,来自 op=list 的顺序)。

expect.description: 该条**当前**文本(内容锚定,防索引漂移)。update/remove 必填。

content.description: update/add 的新文本(单行,≤2000 字符)。

dateSection.description: add 可选:追加到指定日期段(YYYY-MM-DD);缺省追加到文件头部(用户手写区)。

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: 查看自动记忆的当前状态:存储位置、各记忆文件大小、今日日志条数、待反思、上次刷新时间。★**什么时候用**:①用户问「记忆系统正常吗/我的记忆存在哪/有多少条」;②怀疑某轮没写进记忆时自查;③新工作区开工前确认路径对不对。★**不该用于**:每轮例行检查(它是只读诊断,不是流程环节);想看记忆**内容**用 memory_read / memory_recall。

tools.name: memory_trace
tools.description: 白板结构化回溯(P3, 需 boardMode=graph):反向遍历——给定条目 id 回溯它的 cue(入口关键词/路径)、tag 与相邻条目,以及归档版本链(prev_version)。适合「这条结论从哪来」的溯源。

id.description: 条目 id(index.json 里的条目标识)。

tools.name: memory_user
tools.description: 更新用户级记忆 ~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md(跨所有项目的长期规则/偏好,用户明确要求记住时用)。action=append 追加;action=replace 整体替换。有**容量上限**(字符,设置项 userCapacityChars,默认 24000);**超出时的行为**(你不需要自己控制长度,写就是):①先把较早内容交给 AI 折叠成要点(同一层 10 分钟内只整理一次);②整理失败则**整条原文**归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`(信息不丢);③整理后仍超才拒绝(正常不会发生)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:已记住该规则/偏好**。

content.description: 要记住的规则或偏好内容。

action.description: append=追加, replace=整体替换。

tools.name: modlens_read_image
tools.description: Read an image through the modlens vision bridge. Use whenever a message references an image the current model cannot see: a local file path or an http(s) URL to a screenshot, photo, chart, diagram, or document scan. Returns structured evidence with every word transcribed (ocr.full_text), layout regions in reading order, semantics, and an uncertainty list. Quote the evidence instead of guessing. For the same image and focus, call this tool once and reuse its returned evidence instead of calling again. Evidence for a pasted image carries an `attachment-id:` line: to read that image again with a new focus, pass the id as path, and do not search the filesystem for the file. Requires a configured modlens engine (run `npx @liustack/modlens doctor` in a terminal to check).

path.description: Absolute local file path, http(s) URL, or the attachment-id (sha256:...) from pasted-image evidence

prompt.description: Optional extra focus for the reading (e.g. "focus on the axis labels")

tools.name: multi_search
tools.description: Search multiple search engines concurrently and merge/deduplicate ranked results. Cross-source validation with seenIn counts. Use on-demand when high source diversity is needed as it consumes more engine quota.

query.description: The search query.

maxResults.description: Optional result count limit after merge (default 8, max 20).

engines.description: Optional list of engines to query concurrently (defaults to the full language pool for the query, zh/en by script; disabled/cooling/keyless engines are skipped automatically).

tools.name: office_convert
tools.description: Convert a document to another format. Return a temporary file to copy to its destination with the shell.

input.description: Path to doc, docx, odt, xls, xlsx, ods, ppt, pptx, or odp; not modified.

format.description: Word: pdf, docx, odt, txt. Excel: pdf, xlsx, ods, csv. PowerPoint: pdf, pptx, odp.

sheet.description: Exact worksheet name for CSV only; required when the workbook has several sheets.

tools.name: office_recalculate
tools.description: Recalculate spreadsheet formulas. Return a temporary workbook to copy to its destination with the shell.

input.description: Path to an xls, xlsx, or ods workbook; not modified.

format.description: Output workbook format.

tools.name: office_render
tools.description: Render document pages, slides, or worksheet areas as images you can view.

input.description: Path to doc, docx, odt, xls, xlsx, ods, ppt, pptx, odp, or pdf; not modified.

pages.description: Distinct one-based pages or slides; omit for all. Spreadsheets use sheet and range instead.

sheet.description: Exact worksheet name; omit to render every visible sheet.

range.description: A1 range, such as A1:H40; requires sheet. Omit for the used area.

tools.name: platform_search
tools.description: Search a specific platform (GitHub / V2EX / Bilibili / Reddit / Hacker News / Stack Overflow / Wikipedia / npm / YouTube / Vimeo / 掘金 / 豆瓣 / Qiita / X (Twitter)) for a query. Returns source URLs with titles and snippets. Use this when the user asks about repos, code, forum threads, videos, discussions, Q&A, encyclopedia entries, packages, or Chinese/Japanese tech blogs.

platform.description: Platform to search: github, v2ex, bilibili, reddit, hn, stackoverflow, wikipedia, npm, youtube, vimeo, juejin, douban, qiita, x

query.description: The search query.

tools.name: plugin_manager
tools.description: List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

action.description: Management operation.

target.description: Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle.

enabled.description: Required for set operations; defaults to true for installation. For set_version_exemption, true grants and false revokes.

runtimeVersion.description: For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

registry.description: For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable.

offset.description: Zero-based list offset; defaults to 0.

limit.description: List page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Hosts may show presented files only after your turn ends, so call it once the files are final. If the user needs to review files earlier, such as before a tool call that waits for their answer, link them in your message instead. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

tools.name: decompress
tools.description: Restores previously compressed content. Use when you need exact details lost in compression. By default restores one tier up. Use full:true for all the way to original messages. Use toFile to write to file instead of inflating context. Pass imageRef (an mNNNNN ref) to restore a stripped/folded image's original pixels to a file you open with the read tool; imageRef:"list" shows what is restorable. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

toFile.description: Optional: write content to file instead of context

full.description: Restore all the way to original messages

imageRef.description: Optional mNNNNN message ref whose IMAGE payload you want restored (an image that was stripped or folded away). Pass "list" to enumerate every image currently restorable. Restored images are written to host-readable files and their paths returned — open them with the read tool. Independent of blockId/range and of CCR.

tools.name: domain_search
tools.description: Direct lookup in a vertical source (all keyless public APIs). Pick by type: packages/versions->pypi, crates, registries, github_releases, huggingface, endoflife; papers->arxiv, pubmed, crossref, openalex, s2, europepmc, dblp, zenodo, doaj; security->nvd, osv, cisakev; finance->yahoofinance, coingecko, frankfurter, sec_edgar, imf, cfets, cninfo; data->worldbank, wikidata, holidays, worldclock, openmeteo, rdap, gleif; news->googlenews, gdelt, aihot; legal->federalregister, courtlistener, openlegaldata, uk_legislation; zh->so360, sogou.

engine.description: One of: pypi, crates, github_releases, endoflife, registries, huggingface, crossref, openalex, s2, arxiv, pubmed, europepmc, dblp, zenodo, doaj, nvd, osv, cisakev, yahoofinance, coingecko, frankfurter, sec_edgar, imf, cfets, cninfo, worldbank, wikidata, holidays, worldclock, openmeteo, rdap, gleif, googlenews, gdelt, aihot, federalregister, courtlistener, openlegaldata, uk_legislation, so360, sogou.

query.description: The lookup query (package name, keyword, owner/repo, product…).

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: free_search_test
tools.description: Test every configured web search engine and report which ones work. Use this to verify engine availability, diagnose search failures, or check whether an API key is configured.

engines.description: Which engines to test (default: all enabled). ddg, ddg-lite, bing, searxng, degoog, anysearch, exa, tavily, keenable, firecrawl, parallel, perplexity, serpbase, serply, deepseek-official, deepseek-tools, you, baidu, kimi, aliyun, doubao, tinyfish, jina, zhihu_global, zhihu_site, openai, gemini, claude; auto/multi run the virtual routing path. zhihu_* need ZHIHU_API_KEY; openai/gemini/claude bill per search.

query.description: Optional search query to use for the test (default: 'DeepSeek Harness').

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

tools.name: list_subagent_models
tools.description: Inspect the routes available for explicit subagent model selection. No arguments: authorized providers. `provider`: that provider's authorized models. `provider` + `model`: that model and its reasoning efforts. Query when choosing an explicit child route or reasoning effort. Omit optional fields rather than sending empty strings.

model.description: Exact model id; requires provider.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: AI 主动维护长期记忆(做梦式固化):读最近 days 天的工作日志,由 AI 发散提炼出有跨会话长期价值的决策/架构/用户偏好,自动写入项目笔记 MEMORY.md(带日期标题)与用户级 MEMORY.md(跨项目规则),并在正文向用户转述固化结果。★**与「自动沉淀」的边界**:每轮对话结束框架会**自动**评估并写日志/升格要点,**你不需要为日常轮次做这件事**;本工具是**你主动发起的加料**——隔一段时间(或一个阶段收尾时)用来做一次更彻底的提炼,读的是**多日日志**、输出进项目笔记与用户级记忆。⇒ 用它做「阶段性固化」,不要用它替代每轮的 memory_log。

days.description: 读取最近 N 天日志,缺省 7,上限 30。

tools.name: memory_expand
tools.description: 白板结构化展开(P3, 需 boardMode=graph):正向遍历——给定 tag(如 type:dead-end / topic:登录)展开所有匹配的账本/白板条目 Content,默认 limit 10、硬帽 20。返回条目 id、标题、来源(source 文件+行)与判据状态。适合主动重建上下文(如「把所有失败方案列出来」)。

tag.description: 要展开的 tag,如 type:dead-end 或 topic:主题名。

limit.description: 返回条数上限,缺省 10,硬帽 20。

tools.name: memory_external
tools.description: 查看/接入其他 AI 工具(AI 助手/CodeBuddy/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Kimi Code/TRAE/项目约定文件)的记忆。action=list 列出全部检测到的外部记忆源(路径/大小/预览/会话数);action=import **以纯链接模式**接入(source 为源 id,target=project 接进项目笔记 / user 接进用户级记忆)。★**「纯链接模式」的含义**:只在你的记忆里写一条**源文件绝对路径指针**,**不把对方内容抄进来**——目的是①防外部脏内容混入、②对方内容会变而指针不会过期。⇒ 需要内容时**按指针路径读取原文件**或记忆里说明的路径,不要去猜。★首次在新工作区工作时先 list,判断该项目是否曾在其他 AI 工具里做过。首次在新工作区工作、或用户提到其他软件里做过的事时调用。

action.description: list=列出外部记忆源; import=接入指定源。

source.description: 要接入的源 id(action=import 时必填,来自 list 结果)。

target.description: 接入目标: project=项目笔记(默认), user=用户级记忆。

tools.name: memory_log
tools.description: 向当前工作区的 .dsh-memory/ 今日日志追加一条工作记录(append-only,自动建目录/文件)。完成实质性工作(改代码/修 bug/写文档/重构/技术选型/用户偏好约定)后必须调用;有跨会话长期价值的内容在同一轮内一并写入记忆(memory_note 项目/ memory_user 跨项目),progress 与 memory 一起写;不要记录临时信息。**★顺手维护白板(G4/M3,2026-09-17)**:若本次工作让**白板或账本所述与现状不符**(方向变了/阶段完成/旧结论被推翻),请在同一次回复里顺带调用 `memory_note`:项目稳定事实变了用 `kind=plan` 重写白板(旧版自动归档),动态状态变了用 `kind=handoff` 新开一篇账本(append-only,不追改旧账本)。**这是条件触发,不是每回都做**;白板功能关闭时跳过即可,不要因此报错。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文(摘要可见的正文,不是工具调用区)中向用户转述一句:如"已把 X 记入今日日志"**。

note.description: 简短条目:一句话概括做了什么、结果如何。

date.description: 日志日期 YYYY-MM-DD,**缺省今天**。★可补写过去某天(如补记昨天的工作)——会写进那一天的文件,不会覆盖同文件已有内容(append-only)。格式非法时静默回退到今天。

kind.description: ★P6B:条目性质标记(缺省 fact)。rule=用户规则/约定;preference=偏好;todo=待办;fact=事实记录。是规则或用户明确约定的条目请传 kind=rule——它会被规则层识别为必须遵守的约束。纯标记、零额外 LLM 调用。

tools.name: memory_maintain
tools.description: 维护记忆(30 天蒸馏):把 days(缺省30)天前的 .dsh-memory/ 每日日志交给 AI 蒸馏提炼出有长期价值的要点写入项目 MEMORY.md,原文保底归档到 .dsh-memory/archive/ 后从活跃日志移除。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档,不丢信息。★**归档语义(2026-10-13)**:归档 = 冷存储,原文退出常规检索面(**不进 memory_recall 的 all**),只有蒸馏要点经项目笔记继续参与唤回;**不再把全文回灌项目笔记**(那是注入面,回灌会撑大窗口)。取回归档原文:**列目录** memory_read(kind="archive")、**按键找** memory_recall(scope="archive", query="…")、**取全文** memory_read(kind="archive", name="…")。任何情况下都不删归档副本。

days.description: **归档阈值天数**,缺省 30。语义:把**早于「今天 − days 天」**的每日日志挑出来蒸馏,不是「最近 days 天」。**只影响活跃日志的可见性,不删信息**——要点进 MEMORY.md,原文整份归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档。★属**低频维护动作**,不要每轮调。

tools.name: memory_note
tools.description: 更新当前项目长期笔记 .dsh-memory/MEMORY.md(本项目专属的约定、决策、架构要点),或写交接白板。kind=note(默认):action=append 追加一段(自动带日期标题)/action=replace 整体替换(需先基于注入内容或 memory_recall 结果给出完整新内容),本项目笔记有**容量上限**(字符,设置项 noteCapacityChars,默认 24000);**超出时的行为**(你不需要自己控制长度,写就是):①先把较早内容交给 AI 折叠成要点(同一层 10 分钟内只整理一次);②整理失败则**整条原文**归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`(信息不丢);③整理后仍超才拒绝(正常不会发生)。kind=handoff:写一篇四段式交接账本(任务状态/目标/已试方案与失败原因/进度与下一步)到 handoff/,阶段产出或方向变化时用,给下一个上下文窗口续命;**账本/白板内容要落进面板看板泳道,须在标题或正文写 tag**:type:goal / type:state / type:dead-end / type:progress。kind=plan:先 memory_read(kind=plan) 获取版本再写入共享白板 PLAN.md(人能读的项目全貌规划图)。**首建亦可**——工作区若还没有白板,宿主已自动落了一版骨架,你理解全貌后直接整体重写成真内容即可;对项目全貌的理解发生实质变化时同样重写。旧版自动归档。**别把骨架留在那里当白板**。★白板判据 P-H1(硬性):重写后的 PLAN 必须含**至少 1 个 `## ` 顶层节、且该节正文 ≥20 个非空白字符**——只写标题+引言(没有任何成段的 ## 节)会被判据门拒绝。**结论失效时的两个通道(不要混用)**:supersedes=被更新结论取代(有后继);retract=**当时就做错了、直接撤回**(无后继,本身即教训)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:更新了什么**。

content.description: 笔记内容。kind=plan 整篇替换给完整新全貌并带 expectedRevision；单卡更新给完整卡片并带 cardId/expectedCardRevision。

action.description: 仅 kind=note 时有效:append=追加, replace=整体替换。

kind.description: note=项目笔记(默认), handoff=四段式交接账本(新篇), plan=白板全貌重写。 ★plan 重写前必须先 read 磁盘 handoff/PLAN.md 的**原文**并逐条抄回全部 <!--memory:mem_*--> 锚点：注入快照会被截断(显示「…(截断,全文见 handoff/ 白板与账本)」)，不足以据此重写；缺锚点会被保护门拒绝(它会逐条比对前后卡片集合)。每张卡的原文与其用户备注区必须原样带回。

expectedRevision.description: plan 整篇重写必填：memory_read(kind=plan) 返回的 revision。过时版本返回冲突保存路径，不覆盖。

cardId.description: plan 可选条目更新：content 仅提供这一张完整卡（含原锚点），其余卡片保持原文。

expectedCardRevision.description: cardId 更新必填：memory_read(kind=plan) cards 中该卡片 revision。

supersedes.description: （可选）要标为 superseded 的旧条目 memoryId 列表（mem_<32hex>）。**仅在你明确知道被取代的是哪条时传**；不确定就不要传。会在旧条目正文末尾追加一行 `<!-- dsh-status: superseded by=<新条目id> -->`。

retract.description: （可选）要标为 **retracted（撤回）** 的旧条目 memoryId 列表（mem_<32hex>）。**与 supersedes 的分工**：supersedes = 被**更新的结论取代**（有后继结论，可追 mem_id）；**retract = 当时就做错了、直接撤回**（无后继，"错误本身"就是教训）。用户裁定「retracted 不是垃圾，是教训，不过滤只备注」⇒ 检索仍会返回它并标 ⚠已撤回。**强烈建议同时传 retractReason 说明错在哪**。仅在你确知标错的是哪条时传。

retractReason.description: （可选，配合 retract）撤回原因，一行内说明**错在哪**，上限 120 字符。会写成 `reason="…"` 附在状态行上，供检索时显示。

restore.description: （可选）**撤销通道**：把指定 memoryId 的状态改回 current（移除状态行）。用于纠正标错的 superseded/retracted。

archivedIds.description: （可选，仅 kind=plan 有意义）要**显式归档**的卡片 id 列表（mem_<32hex>）。用于白板重写时有意移除某张卡：列进来即视为"合法消失（有留痕）"，不会被丢卡检查拦下。**只在你确实要移除该卡时传**；顺手漏抄卡片不要用它掩盖——那属于内容丢失，应改回原样带回。

tools.name: memory_procedure
tools.description: 把一个**值得复用的流程**写进 procedure memory（技能库）——这是模型直写通路，取代此前的机械生成。什么时候用：你刚跑通了一个多步骤流程、踩坑后总结出了正确做法、或发现某个操作值得下次照做时。**判据**：有明确步骤、可重复、下次遇到类似场景能直接照做。**已有条目要改就用 action=update（传 procedureId），不要另写一条同名新条目**；action=write 进审批列表（保守，推荐先这样）；action=activate 一步到位激活并可被自动召回（仅当你确信它稳定可复用）。写出的条目须含 title + steps，建议一并给 successCriteria（**没有 successCriteria 的条目永远无法晋升**）。

action.description: write=写入并进审批列表（默认）；activate=写入后直接晋升并激活（可被召回，同时自动导出 SKILL.md）。

procedureId.description: 仅 action=update 时需要：要修订的条目 id（完整或前 20 位短码）。

title.description: 一句话说清这是什么流程（如「发布前跑全量回归并核对 SHA256」）。不要用运行时样板文字或纯提问句。**action=write/activate 必填**（缺则明确拒绝）；**action=update 可省略**（要改标题才传）。

steps.description: 流程步骤，**一行一步**（换行分隔）；行首的 "1. " / "- " 会自动去掉。**action=write/activate 必填**（缺则明确拒绝）。

successCriteria.description: 怎么算跑通，一行一条。**强烈建议填写**——缺它则该条目结构上无法晋升。

preconditions.description: 前置条件，一行一条（可选）。

checks.description: 过程中要检查的点，一行一条（可选）。

rollback.description: 失败时怎么回滚，一行一条（可选）。

riskLevel.description: 风险等级，缺省 low。high 会要求人工批准后才可激活。

tools.name: memory_procedure_list
tools.description: 只读浏览技能库(procedure memory)：列出两库里已有哪些流程条目，含**它属于哪个库**（工作区库 / 通用库）、阶段、证据量与「为什么还不能晋升」的原因码。用于**动手写之前先查重**：你要写的流程是否已经存在？是补修它还是新建？也可用 query 做关键词粗筛。**本工具纯只读，不写盘、不晋升、不改任何条目。**

scope.description: 只看哪个库：workspace=工作区库 / global=通用库 / all=两库都看（默认）。

query.description: 关键词粗筛（匹配标题/步骤/完成标准，不区分大小写；可选）。

limit.description: 最多返回条数，缺省 30，硬帽 100。

includeNoise.description: ★#453：是否包含「低质量观察行」（纯 episode 观察行 / 缺 successCriteria 的候选）。缺省 false = 折叠并在末尾提示条数；传 true 才全部列出。

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: 按需读取记忆文件完整内容(某日日志/反思全文、用户级记忆、项目笔记、日历、**已归档旧日志**),注入上下文只含精简摘要,需要细节时用本工具,不要要求用户粘贴。★**kind=archive 是取回 30 天前归档原文的入口**——归档后原文退出常规检索面(冷存储分层),需显式取;可用 memory_recall(scope="archive") 先找文件名。

kind.description: 读取类型: log=某日日志, reflection=某日反思, user=用户级记忆, notes=项目笔记, calendar=日历, plan=白板, **archive=已归档的旧日志(30 天前的日志原文,冷存储,不在常规检索面,需显式取)**。

name.description: 仅 kind=archive:归档文件名(如 2026-01-01.md)。**缺省=列出全部归档文件**;给了=返回该文件全文。可用 memory_recall(scope="archive") 先按关键词定位文件名。

date.description: 日期 YYYY-MM-DD(仅 log/reflection 需要,缺省今天)。

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: 检索记忆:本地记忆文件(当前工作区 + 其他所有工作区的每日日志、项目笔记、用户级记忆、反思、交接白板)关键词匹配 + 历史 DSH 会话全文检索(如部署启用)。开发/排查中不懂的、用户提到过去的做法/讨论/决定而当前上下文没有时调用——跨工作区的记忆也能检索到(结果标注来源工作区)。查询必须自包含。默认返回 L0 摘要列表(每条含 id/得分/匹配原因,省 token);需要某条完整原文时传 expand="mem_xxx" 按需展开(渐进式加载)。scope=handoff 只搜交接白板语料(白板 PLAN+交接账本——接续长任务时先查这里);scope=sessions 只搜历史会话；**scope=archive 检索 30 天前的已归档旧日志**(归档原文退出常规面属冷存储分层,不在 all 里;命中给文件名+命中行,正文用 memory_read(kind="archive", name=…) 取)。**检索后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:检索了什么、找到什么(或没找到)**。

query.description: 检索关键词或自包含描述;expand 时填该记忆 id 即可。

limit.description: 最多返回条数,缺省 8。

scope.description: 检索范围:all=全部(默认,**不含 archive**), handoff=交接白板语料(跨窗口续命材料), sessions=历史 DSH 会话, **archive=已归档的旧日志(30 天前原文,冷存储,需显式指定)**。★命中给「文件名+命中行」,正文用 memory_read(kind="archive", name=…) 取(两段式)。

format.description: 本地记忆命中格式:l0=L0 摘要列表(默认,每条含 id/得分/匹配原因),full=整条原文(旧行为)。

expand.description: 按记忆 id(mem_ + 32 个十六进制字符)展开该条完整原文。★**提供 expand 时 query 只作占位、检索语义被忽略**(仍必填,随便填该 id 即可);这是**两段式用法**:先用默认 l0 拿到候选列表与 id,再对感兴趣的那条 expand 取全文,避免一次性灌入大量原文。

tools.name: memory_reflect

tools.name: memory_rules
tools.description: 用户级硬性约束(每轮无条件注入的 [规则] 段,真源 ~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md)的**条目级增删改**。op=list 列出全部条目(0 基序号/来源日期段/文本);op=add 追加;op=update 改写一条;op=remove **真删**一条。★**删/改必须带 expect**(=该条**当前**文本,从 list 原样回填),不符即拒 —— 防索引漂移删错行。★这段**每轮注入且不参与裁剪**,所以它同时是 prompt 成本的主要来源:清理过时条目的首选手段就是本工具的 remove(而不是把整篇用户级记忆用 memory_user replace 重写)。★status 被标 superseded/retracted 的条目自 P9 起**不再进规则段**,但仍留在 list 里(要彻底消失用 remove;要软失效用 memory_note 的 retract/supersedes)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述改了什么**。

expect.description: 该条**当前**文本(内容锚定,防索引漂移)。update/remove 必填。

content.description: update/add 的新文本(单行,≤2000 字符)。

Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

If the user needs to review files earlier, such as before a tool call that waits for their answer, link them in your message instead. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: Instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Omit `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` to use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: acp_cache
tools.description: Prompt-cache reconciliation: grand ledger (total input/cached/output, overall hit rate) with every request's miss split into new content / compression re-pay / upstream-ttl-or-client-rewrite (unattributed stable-prefix misses), plus per-fold economics (breakeven turns vs measured cadence). Defaults to a compact summary (totals + verdicts + anomalies only); pass detail="full" for every fold and line item. Read-only. Call when asked about cache hits, cache invalidation, or what compression costs. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

detail.description: "summary" (default): totals, verdicts, notable folds, anomalous requests only. "full": every retained fold and line item.

tools.name: acp_read_original_image
tools.description: Read the ORIGINAL full-resolution image of a message whose picture was downscaled before reaching you. Beside each shrunken image there is a [bili] note quoting its mNNNNN ref and both sizes — pass that ref here. The original bytes are returned as an image attached to this result. The original can be much larger than the downscaled copy, so call this only when you actually need full-resolution detail (small text, colors, pixel alignment); the downscaled version is enough for most work.

ref.description: The mNNNNN message ref quoted in the [bili] downsample note beside the shrunken image.

tools.name: acp_status
tools.description: Show context usage and compressible ranges. No args = overview. Use to find what to compress next. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

tools.name: advanced_search
tools.description: Search the web with optional time filtering. Use when the user wants results from a specific time window (e.g. 'last week', 'this month') or when you need to force a specific engine. Falls back across engines automatically just like web_search.

query.description: The search query.

timeRange.description: Optional time filter. Fixed tiers: day, week, month, year. Custom: relative like 12h, 3d, 2mo, 1y, or an absolute date like 2026-07-01 (published after that date). Exa/Keenable apply it precisely; Tavily/SearXNG/DDG map to the nearest tier.

engine.description: Optional search mode/engine: multi (parallel language-pool merge), auto, or one of ddg, ddg-lite, bing, searxng, degoog, anysearch, exa, tavily, keenable, firecrawl, parallel, perplexity, serpbase, serply, deepseek-official, deepseek-tools, you, baidu, kimi, aliyun, doubao, tinyfish, jina, zhihu_global, zhihu_site, openai, gemini, claude. openai/gemini/claude are model-based and explicit-only.

An answer item with empty selected and no custom means the user skipped that question: continue without it, do not ask it again, and do not treat the skip as permission.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: cache_search
tools.description: Full-text search over pages previously fetched by the research tool (persistent local cache, entries up to 7 days old). Use to re-find earlier research material without re-fetching.

query.description: Text to look for in cached page titles and bodies.

limit.description: Max entries to return (default 8).

tools.name: compress
tools.description: Replace consumed conversation ranges with self-contained summaries you write, identified by their refs. content = ONE plain string holding ALL ranges — each block starts with its 'm00150–m00220 optional topic' header line followed by that block's summary (a valid JSON string — internal quotes \", newlines \n; a JSON-encoded array as that string is also accepted for gateways that stringify arrays). Batch multiple ranges into ONE call — do not split into one call per range. Use when content is genuinely consumed. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool. Context management is provided by billion-context — report billion-context problems at github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/issues.

content.description: ONE plain string holding ALL ranges to compress — each block starts with its 'm00150–m00220 optional topic' header line followed by that block's summary markdown (a valid JSON string: internal quotes \" and newlines \n; a JSON-encoded array as that string is also accepted). Batch multiple ranges into ONE call — do not split into one call per range.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: decompress
tools.description: Restores previously compressed content. Use when you need exact details lost in compression. By default restores one tier up. Use full:true for all the way to original messages. Use toFile to write to file instead of inflating context. Pass imageRef (an mNNNNN ref) to restore a stripped/folded image's original pixels to a file you open with the read tool; imageRef:"list" shows what is restorable. Calling convention: if this environment only allows `run_code` to be called directly (code-mode/PTC harness), call this tool from inside a run_code program via the harness's generated SDK; otherwise call it directly as a tool.

toFile.description: Optional: write content to file instead of context

full.description: Restore all the way to original messages

imageRef.description: Optional mNNNNN message ref whose IMAGE payload you want restored (an image that was stripped or folded away). Pass "list" to enumerate every image currently restorable. Restored images are written to host-readable files and their paths returned — open them with the read tool. Independent of blockId/range and of CCR.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

tools.description: Test every configured web search engine and report which ones work. Use this to verify engine availability, diagnose search failures, or check whether an API key is configured.

engines.description: Which engines to test (default: all enabled). ddg, ddg-lite, bing, searxng, degoog, anysearch, exa, tavily, keenable, firecrawl, parallel, perplexity, serpbase, serply, deepseek-official, deepseek-tools, you, baidu, kimi, aliyun, doubao, tinyfish, jina, zhihu_global, zhihu_site, openai, gemini, claude; auto/multi run the virtual routing path. zhihu_* need ZHIHU_API_KEY; openai/gemini/claude bill per search.
